resources.string: Morphus needs your location to share it with emergency contacts when SOS is triggered. Your location is never tracked outside of emergencies.
To send your location even when the app is in the background, please select \"Allow all the time\" on the next screen.
Morphus sends emergency SMS messages with your location to your trusted contacts during an SOS event.
Allows Morphus to automatically call emergency services or your trusted contacts when SOS is activated.
Morphus can silently record ambient audio during an emergency to provide evidence and context for responders.
The accessibility service allows Morphus to detect trigger gestures system-wide, even when the app is in the background. Tap the button below to open Settings.
